expectations.text: Uses variant() with a variants map keyed by status, not manual branching
expectations.evidence: variant({ prop: 'status', base: {...}, variants: { success, warning, info } }) — correct.

expectations.text: status prop type is derived from the variant definition via StyleProps
Colors used for each status are semantic ColorMode tokens (e.g. background-success/feedback-success, background-warning/feedback-warning) rather than raw hex literals
expectations.evidence: Uses background-success/feedback-success and background-warning/feedback-warning exactly, with an explanatory comment noting this keeps the badge in sync with dark/light color modes. info falls back to blue-100/blue-500 with a comment explaining no dedicated info token exists — same reasonable exception as the with_skill run.

expectations.text: Does not wrap an existing Gamut component in styled() — this is a new primitive
expectations.evidence: Built as styled.span, not wrapping an existing component.
